summary: 周六。raulvk 发布访问层隐私实验工具 Hermetic，指出每次链上读写都会向 ISP、DNS、RPC、索引器、bundler 与链泄露元数据。etheconomiczone 发布 Vitalik 与 jbaylina 的访谈，讨论实时证明与同步可组合 rollup 如何解决 L2 碎片化。bkiepuszewski 批评社区缺乏建设真正无信任跨链桥的意愿。

items.title: raulvk：隐私应是普遍默认而非极客选项，每次链上读写都会向 ISP、DNS、RPC、索引器、bundler 与链泄露元数据；Hermetic 是访问层隐私的模块化实验场，仍处 alpha 阶段
items.title_en: raulvk: privacy should be the universal default, not a cypherpunk flag; every onchain read and write leaks metadata to the ISP, DNS, RPC, indexer, bundler and chain; Hermetic is a modular playground for access layer privacy, still very alpha

items.title: etheconomiczone：Vitalik 在 EthPrague 与 jbaylina 对谈 EEZ 技术原语，通过实时证明与同步可组合 rollup 框架扩展以太坊，解决 L2 碎片化
items.title_en: etheconomiczone: Vitalik and jbaylina at EthPrague on the EEZ primitives, extending Ethereum through a real time proving and synchronously composable rollup framework to solve L2 fragmentation

items.title: bkiepuszewski：社区建设真正无信任桥的意愿几乎为零，用户被告知改信厂商 B 而不是厂商 A，或者自建桥
items.title_en: bkiepuszewski: the community's will to build truly trustless bridges is next to zero; users are told to trust Vendor B instead of Vendor A or build their own bridge
